# idb-activerecord

> ActiveRecord-style ORM for IndexedDB with TypeScript support, reactive queries, and turnkey multi-tenant Turso cloud sync.

idb-activerecord provides an intuitive ActiveRecord ORM interface for client-side persistence in the browser, direct server execution via Turso libSQL, and bidirectional synchronization with multi-tenant authentication.

## Package Exports

- `idb-activerecord` (`.`): Core ActiveRecord model, Database connection, QueryBuilder, Migration, and sync interfaces.
- `idb-activerecord/server` (`./server`): Web-standard `createSyncHandler` for Astro, Next.js App Router, Hono, and Node servers.
- `idb-activerecord/agent` (`./agent`): AgentContext, whyIsntThisWorking diagnostics, and code generators.
- `idb-activerecord/erd` (`./erd`): Bidirectional ERD diagram generation (Mermaid, PlantUML, SQLite DDL) and model scaffolding.
- `idb-activerecord/react` (`./react`): SSR-safe `useLiveQuery` hook for React.
- `idb-activerecord/turso-adapter` (`./turso-adapter`): `TursoAdapter` (sync) and `TursoStorageAdapter` (SSR/server mode).
- `idb-activerecord/sqlite-adapter` (`./sqlite-adapter`): `SQLiteAdapter` for Node.js `node:sqlite`.
- `idb-activerecord/sync-server` (`./sync-server`): Standalone development sync server.

## Day-0: Zero-Config Quick Start

Agents and developers can define an ActiveRecord model and query it immediately without manual database instantiation, registration, or connection:

```ts
import { ActiveRecord } from 'idb-activerecord';

class Task extends ActiveRecord {
  static tableName = 'tasks';
}

// Automatically connects to Database.default and provisions the store on first query:
const task = await Task.create({ title: 'Zero-config Day 0 POC' });
const pending = await Task.where('title', 'like', '%POC%').all();
```

## Model Definition & Schema Declaration

Declare columns, indexes, validations, and relationships directly on your model:

```ts
import { ActiveRecord } from 'idb-activerecord';

export class Task extends ActiveRecord<Task> {
  static tableName = 'tasks';
  static enableSync = true;
  static softDelete = true;
  static timestamps = true;

  static columns = {
    title: { type: 'string', nullable: false },
    completed: { type: 'boolean', default: false },
    priority: { type: 'integer', default: 0 },
    metadata: { type: 'json', nullable: true }
  };

  static indexes = [
    { name: 'idx_tasks_completed', keyPath: 'completed' },
    { name: 'idx_tasks_priority', keyPath: 'priority' }
  ];

  static validates = {
    title: { presence: true, length: { minimum: 1, maximum: 200 } }
  };
}
```

## Reactive UI with React (`useLiveQuery`)

Use `useLiveQuery` to automatically re-render React components whenever records are created, updated, soft-deleted, or synced from the remote server:

```tsx
import { useLiveQuery } from 'idb-activerecord/react';
import { Task } from './models/task';

export function TaskList() {
  const tasks = useLiveQuery(() => Task.where('completed', false).all(), []);

  if (!tasks) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  return (
    <ul>
      {tasks.map(t => (
        <li key={t.id}>{t.title}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

## Day-N: Production Turso Cloud Sync

### Server Sync Handler (Next.js App Router)

```ts
// src/app/api/sync/[...table]/route.ts
import { createClient } from '@libsql/client';
import { createSyncHandler } from 'idb-activerecord/server';

const client = createClient({
  url: process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL!,
  authToken: process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN!
});

const handler = createSyncHandler({
  client,
  basePath: '/api/sync',
  autoProvision: true,
  getSessionUser: async (req) => {
    const auth = req.headers.get('Authorization');
    return auth?.replace('Bearer ', '') || null; // 401 if null
  }
});

export { handler as GET, handler as POST, handler as DELETE };
```

### Client Database with 1-Line Auto-Sync

```ts
import { Database } from 'idb-activerecord';
import { Task } from './models/task';

const db = new Database('app', {
  sync: {
    url: '/api/sync',
    auto: true,
    interval: 30000,
    offlineQueue: true,
    getAuthHeaders: async () => ({
      Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('token')}`
    })
  }
});

db.registerModel(Task);
await db.connect();

// Backfill pre-existing local records created before sync was configured:
await db.backfillSync();
```

## Direct SSR Mode (TursoStorageAdapter)

In server-side rendering (SSR), API routes, or Node.js workers where `indexedDB` does not exist, pass `TursoStorageAdapter` to execute models directly against Turso:

```ts
import { createClient } from '@libsql/client';
import { Database, ActiveRecord } from 'idb-activerecord';
import { TursoStorageAdapter } from 'idb-activerecord/turso-adapter';

class Task extends ActiveRecord {
  static tableName = 'tasks';
}

const client = createClient({
  url: process.env.TURSO_DATABASE_URL!,
  authToken: process.env.TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN!
});

const db = new Database('app', {
  storage: new TursoStorageAdapter({ client })
});
db.registerModel(Task);
await db.connect();

// Standard ActiveRecord queries work directly against Turso:
const activeTasks = await Task.where('completed', false).all();
```

## Agent Diagnostics & Introspection

```ts
import { whyIsntThisWorking, explainDatabase } from 'idb-activerecord/agent';

try {
  await Task.create({ title: 'New task' });
} catch (err) {
  const diagnosis = whyIsntThisWorking({ error: err });
  console.log('Problem:', diagnosis.problem);
  console.log('Solution:', diagnosis.solution);
  console.log('Code fix:', diagnosis.codeFix);
}

// Tree view of database state:
console.log(db.explain());
```

## CLI & Bidirectional ERD Tooling

```bash
# Export SQLite DDL for Turso migrations:
npx idb-activerecord export-schema --input schema.mmd --format sqlite --sync-columns

# Scaffold TypeScript models from a Mermaid ERD:
npx idb-activerecord erd generate-models --input schema.mmd --output ./src/models --sync

# Export Mermaid ERD from existing Database or models:
npx idb-activerecord erd generate --input ./src/db.js --format mermaid
```

Programmatic ERD API:
```ts
import { generateERD, exportToMermaid, parseMermaid, generateModels } from 'idb-activerecord/erd';

const erd = generateERD(db);
const mermaid = exportToMermaid(erd);

const parsed = parseMermaid(mermaid);
const models = generateModels(parsed, { language: 'typescript', includeSync: true });
```
